title: Exterior Paint Quality and Finish Concerns
summary: Reviews in this topic center on exterior paint preferences and paint-related complaints, with negative feedback focusing on visible paint imperfections and the upkeep burden of matte finishes.

positive.summary: Positive feedback is limited to a preference for white exterior paint rather than praise of paint quality or durability.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe factory paint defects such as dirt in the finish and a dark spot under the clear coat, along with matte paint being hard to keep clean because it cannot go through a car wash.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined feedback reflects exterior color preference for a lighter paint over black without a clear evaluation of paint quality.

limitations: The sample is very small, so the examples are insufficient to support broader conclusions beyond the specific paint issues and preferences shown here.
The positive and undetermined examples focus on color preference rather than paint workmanship, so sentiment evidence on actual exterior paint quality is limited.
